meta.title: Rewrite dev/preview_docs.py in JavaScript to simplify preview-docs workflow
meta.body_summary: Replace the Python script dev/preview_docs.py with a JavaScript implementation using github-script to eliminate Python dependency and speed up CI runs in the preview-docs workflow.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot script migration with narrative CI speedup claim; multiple review iterations on naming, scope, and style; merged after 14h with two approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2286 changed lines across 17 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume, but includes many unrelated doc deletions from a merge. As a CI workflow performance PR, it merged after extensive review and fixes.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewers suggested renaming the script, removing outdated comments, using context for repo, adding pagination, and minor style tweaks.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate Python setup to speed up CI runs by removing pip install and reducing complexity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot successfully rewrote a Python script to JavaScript for CI, navigating multiple review iterations on naming and code structure; the merge required human oversight for style and logging.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers reviewed inline, suggested naming, variable scope, per_page parameter, and removal of stale comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after CI run time provided; migration's performance benefit is claimed but not measured.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Copilot agent responded to each inline comment by committing fixes; maintainers also committed some adjustments.

core_change_summary.description: Replace dev/preview_docs.py with .github/workflows/preview-comment.js that uses github-script to upsert PR comments for documentation preview. Rewrite preview-docs.yml to use the JS script and remove Python setup steps.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many doc files were removed in a merge from master, unrelated to the performance claim.
change_trajectory: Implement JavaScript replacement for dev/preview_docs.py (new file, workflow changes).
Apply suggestion: remove outdated comment about Python replacement.
Rename variable, add per_page parameter, extract owner/repo from context.
Merge master, resolve conflicts, apply final formatting fixes.

review_signals.summary: Requested setting per_page in listComments to handle many comments.
